name: Nike Dunk Low SB 'White Gum'
story_html: The Nike Dunk Low SB 'White Gum' outfits the retro silhouette in an essential two-tone design. The white leather upper is contrasted by a black signature Swoosh. A woven Nike SB tag adorns the stuffed mesh tongue, which combines with a padded low-cut collar to deliver a comfortable fit. The insole packs a Zoom Air unit in the heel for lightweight cushioning and impact protection. Underfoot, a grippy gum rubber outsole offers superior board feel.
